# §6 Portal Engagement — Highlight Candidates

1. **Modest but consistent portal audience** — RENWIL's eCat Online portal averaged ~1.4 daily visitors and 1,083 total pageviews across 7 tracked months (Dec 2025 – Jun 2026), with sessions averaging 2:35. [→ §portal]
2. **January traffic peak at 288 pageviews** — January 2026 was the strongest portal month with 288 pageviews, 1.87 avg daily visitors, and 3:41 avg session duration — the highest engagement of the trailing period. [→ §portal]
